defs.meaning: 表明，标示；象征，暗示；间接提及，示意；指示，指出；<英>（用灯光或手臂）打行车转向信号；有必要，被建议

examples.en: The extent of the rise might indicate that it had been overdone.
examples.zh: 上涨的程度可能显示事情做得过头了。

examples.en: Early results indicate that the government will be returned to power.
examples.zh: 早期的结果预示这个政府将重新执政。

examples.en: Surveys indicate that supporters of the treaty are still in the majority.
examples.zh: 调查显示该条约的支持者仍占多数。
